text: Machine learning is a type of technology that helps computers learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that the computer creates after studying the examples. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess if an email is spam or not. The accuracy of these predictions shows how well the model has learned. Good training data usually leads to better accuracy.
